title: Youth-Led Career Fair!
description:
Hundreds of young people, ages 16 to 24, who live or go to school in the San Diego Promise Zone, had a chance to explore their future at the fourth annual Youth-Led Career Fair on Tuesday, March 3, 2026. 

The Promise Zone, which extends from East Village and Barrio Logan east to Encanto, includes some of the city’s most culturally rich and ethnically diverse neighborhoods, but also some of its most under-resourced communities.
